description: Returns the latest Form 13F-HR holdings for an institutional investor by CIK or name search. Each holding: issuer, class, CUSIP, value in USD, shares, put/call flag, largest first. Capped at 500 rows. Also returns the total value from the cover page, filing date and reporting period. Source: SEC EDGAR (public domain). EDGAR requests ≤10/s. Price: $0.004 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

cik.description: Filer CIK number (10-digit, with or without leading zeros)

limit.description: Max holdings rows to return (1–500, default 100)

name.description: Filer name to search EDGAR (used when cik is not given; picks the top match)

name: sec_13f
title: Sec 13f
